skills.description: Deterministic equity and shareholder-resolution calculator for founders and board secretaries. Statutory anchor verified in text, Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision, effective 2024-07-01) Article 66, resolutions need more than half of all voting rights while amending articles, changing registered capital, merger, division, dissolution or form need two-thirds or more, otherwise the articles govern. It maps the cap table with power positions, decides a vote from total and present voting rights with an overridable charter threshold and the distance to the gate, finds the smallest winning coalition and sole blockers, computes single and multi-round dilution with an optional option pool and the crossings of 50 percent, two thirds and the blocking line, and models cliff and linear vesting. Pure standard library, 25 assertions including the exact 500/501 and 666/667 boundaries, Markdown memo to file. One share one vote is assumed; not legal advice.
